verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an official MCP server that AI assistants connect to through a browser OAuth flow (log in, review the request, pick a workspace). It also supports scoped service keys for agent automation, and the assistant acts within the member's role with every action attributed to their account. Missing for 10: documentation of which tools and actions the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the connection works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: add the Oneleet MCP server to your assistant, and it opens a browser window where you log in to Oneleet, review what the assistant is asking for, and pick the workspace it should work in.
Once connected, the assistant acts as you. It can only see and do what your own role in the workspace allows, and every action is attributed to your account.
Use service keys for AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts to interact with your Oneleet workspace.
Grant Full access to all tenant service-key scopes, or choose Limit access to… to grant only specific scopes.
